protocol.title: Cross-sectional options implied-vol SKEW basis (BTC-vs-ETH relative near-ATM put-call skew) -> subsequent relative return-tail-asymmetry spread (BTC-minus-ETH forward tail asymmetry): wrapper-free Spearman rank information coefficient (predictiveness) falsification on the real on-disk three-way captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-77 (same cross-sectional BTC-vs-ETH alignment and ``_relative_signal_series``, reused verbatim) and EVAL-85 (same forward return-tail-asymmetry target, reused verbatim) but a DISTINCT cell: the *cross-sectional skew basis* (not the single-underlying skew of EVAL-85, not the skew basis -> relative VRP of EVAL-89, not the skew basis -> relative vol-of-vol of EVAL-91, not the term basis -> relative tail asymmetry of EVAL-105/106) with the forward relative *tail-asymmetry* spread; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — this is the skew-basis partner to EVAL-85 (own-asset skew -> own tail asymmetry), EVAL-89/91 (skew basis -> relative VRP / vol-of-vol) and EVAL-105/106 (term basis -> relative tail asymmetry). It makes a predictiveness claim only, no traded-form / monetization claim

cross_section.target: y_k = tail_asym_BTC(k) - tail_asym_ETH(k) with tail_asym_i(k) = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) over the next H perp log returns strictly after k (relative tail-asymmetry spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM put-call skew (EVAL-71 ``build_surface_bars``: skew = mean(put iv) - mean(call iv) over near-ATM trades); the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-zscored end-of-bar k on the EVAL-77 common aligned bar grid (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore).
protocol.target_detail: forward relative tail-asymmetry spread: per underlying tail_asym = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) over the next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, EVAL-85 ``_forward_return_tail_asym`` verbatim), then BTC minus ETH on the common aligned bar grid
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, y_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0, relatively positive ETH-minus-BTC skew basis predicts BTC subsequently carries a relatively richer forward tail-asymmetry spread)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative tail-asymmetry spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH floors satisfied, at least one config (skew basis x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
